mapper.sql: id, course_id AS courseId, title, description, points_possible AS pointsPossible, due_at AS dueAt, late_until AS lateUntil, submission_type AS submissionType, group_set_id AS groupSetId, allowed_file_types AS allowedFileTypes, max_file_size_bytes AS maxFileSizeBytes, max_file_count AS maxFileCount, state, publication_version AS publicationVersion, schedule_version AS scheduleVersion, current_rubric_version_id AS currentRubricVersionId, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assignment ( course_id, title, description, points_possible, due_at, late_until, submission_type, group_set_id, allowed_file_types, max_file_size_bytes, max_file_count, state, current_rubric_version_id, created_by ) VALUES ( #{courseId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{pointsPossible}, #{dueAt}, #{lateUntil}, #{submissionType}, #{groupSetId}, #{allowedFileTypes}, #{maxFileSizeBytes}, #{maxFileCount}, #{state}, #{currentRubricVersionId}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM assignment WHERE course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY due_at, id

SELECT
FROM assignment WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND state = #{state} ORDER BY due_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE assignment SET state = 'Published', publication_version = publication_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND state <> 'Published'
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, a.title, a.due_at AS dueAt, a.late_until AS lateUntil, a.submission_type AS submissionType, a.group_set_id AS groupSetId FROM assignment a INNER JOIN enrollment e ON e.course_id = a.course_id AND e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.active = 1 INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = a.course_id INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = #{userId} WHERE a.state = 'Published' AND c.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND a.due_at IS NOT NULL AND a.due_at >= #{fromUtc} AND a.due_at <= #{toUtc} ORDER BY a.due_at ASC, a.course_id ASC, a.id ASC
